description: Dublin City Council Road Network is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. This dataset contains details on all roads within Dublin City Council. The dataset was derived from Ordnance Survey Mapping, along with road classifications lists and Dublin City Council Roads In Charge records. This dataset is considered 90% complete. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are dublin, road, road network, traffic infrastructure, transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
